title: ModelResponse
description: Prompt mode: the learner describes a scene in words, the model writes scene code for the engine API. The server validates every reply against this file and server/model_validate.py before the page sees it.

code.description: JavaScript that only calls the engine commands unlocked for this learner. Runs in the page's Web Worker sandbox.

explanation.description: What the code does, in the learner's language, so they learn by reading it.

uses.description: The engine commands the code calls. The server checks this against the code.

model.description: Model id that produced the reply, set by the server.
